text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86160, Traditional Nunez Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

The Nunez Sandcast Bronze Back-to-Back Pulls comes packaged as a set of 2 door pulls and the hardware to mount them back-to-back on your front door. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. Choose from matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes, all of which are highlighted beautifully through the inherent rustic nature that the sandcasting process creates. The Traditional Nunez Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair has an 8 inch center to center length and an 9-7/8 overall length.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Nunez Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rustic Nunez Sandcast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Total Length: 9-7/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Base: 13/16"
  • Clearance: 1-11/16"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
